full_judgment: motive of frustrating the claim of the original plaintiffs. Another aspect of the case cannot be altogether ignored and that is the opposite party Nos. 15-64 have not been left with no remedy rather they are at liberty to raise their claim in a separate suit subject of course with the law of limitation. But a suit already instituted by the original plaintiffs cannot be allowed to be adversely affected by bringing new set of plaintiffs in the suit like the opposite party Nos.I5-64.
